name: Tonkaja Gran'
source:
For a person living through the same week over and over again, even the most beautiful place becomes worse than hell. One of the Semyons, trapped in his cycles, lost count of the years he spent here long ago.

The other camp inhabitants concern him little now, but when a chance to break free presents itself, he must decide whether he is truly worthy of salvation - or if the sins of the past have long since consumed his soul.
